subject.title: Feature: Pre-compaction agent notification, structured handoff window, and deferral mechanism

question: Should OpenClaw add an agent-controlled pre-compaction lifecycle contract, and which scope is allowed: warnings only, structured handoff/checkpoint, bounded deferral, or no new lifecycle surface?
rationale: The request crosses product UX, public config, persisted session state, and security boundaries because it can change when agents get extra write opportunities and whether compaction may be delayed under context pressure.

options.title: Adopt Warning And Handoff Only
options.body: Add a narrow opt-in warning plus structured handoff/checkpoint path while leaving agent-requested deferral out until authority semantics are settled.

options.title: Adopt Full Bounded Deferral
options.body: Allow warning, handoff, and DEFER only with explicit max duration, audit trail, idempotent checkpoint matching, and expiry rules.

options.title: Decline New Lifecycle Surface
options.body: Keep current memoryFlush, notifyUser, hooks, and checkpoints as the supported compaction surfaces and route remaining needs to docs or plugins.

recommendation.title: Adopt Warning And Handoff Only
recommendation.body: Add a narrow opt-in warning plus structured handoff/checkpoint path while leaving agent-requested deferral out until authority semantics are settled.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-history signal for the adjacent memoryFlush lifecycle surface points to steipete, and the decision spans product and security policy.
